summary: Implemented per-fighter punch cancellation and windup continuity in the existing presentation layer.
implementation: Player feint retracts the captured hand over P.busy_t and leaves the opponent's strike intact.
Authored jab interrupt releases the opponent's captured coil without removing the player's resolving punch. Unbroken strings retain their offense.
Deterministic tell descriptor preserves body targets; rendering does not parse RNG-selected actions.
Tell preload, cancellation and delivery use the fight clock excluding hitstop.
Delayed variants retain a partial feint then deliver within the authored hold. Redirected variants blend outgoing and replacement body/hand poses within the existing tell.

visual_review.observed: Loaded stance flows into delayed delivery; redirected tell transitions into the actual left hook while the opponent remains visible. The previous neutral reset is removed.
visual_review.next_gate: PAC-202B explicitly owns fixed segment lengths, stable joint attachments and visual/resolver reach agreement, followed by weight transfer, full combinations, style/build expression and sustained boxing validation.

test_corrections: Preserved baseline 8/14 and first correction 11/14. R_HAY maps to R_HOOKERCUT, not R_FLARED.
Planted boot continuity is measured in world coordinates; local coordinates intentionally compensate for the sim's existing 0.30m boss lunge. The 0.25m non-support joint threshold remains.
diagnostics: Known Windows root certificate-store diagnostic remains in logs.
Headless shutdown ObjectDB warnings remain in logs; no script or assertion errors in passing runs. GPU lifecycle exited without the headless leak warning.
acceptance: This report closes the listed motion lifecycle implementation. Whole-boxing exit remains PAC-202B through PAC-202F; connected game acceptance remains PAC-204 and OGM-025. Tests do not substitute for that work.
